label: TP
reason: User input from query string flows directly into HTML output via PrintWriter.format() without proper escaping. The code decodes URL-encoded characters but does not sanitize or encode special characters (like < > & " ') required to prevent XSS. The X-XSS-Protection header set to '0' disables browser-based XSS protection, leaving the application vulnerable.

evidence.note: User-controlled variable 'bar' (derived from query string) is passed to format method which outputs unescaped HTML content.
URL decoding applied but no subsequent sanitization or encoding of potentially malicious characters.
X-XSS-Protection header disabled ('0'), removing browser-level XSS mitigation.
